title: Specwright pre-ship review findings
description: The output of a pre-ship review. Rule the script enforces beyond this schema: spec_class must be clarification or behaviour_change (not null) when category is spec.

summary.description: One or two sentences on the state of the change.

id.description: A short id unique within this review, for example F1.

file.description: Path of the file the finding is about, relative to the repository.

line.description: Line number in the new version of the file, or null.

body.description: What is wrong, why it matters, and what would fix it.

spec_class.description: Required (not null) when category is spec: clarification or behaviour_change. Null for every other category.
